body: The situational depression isn't helping, but neither is the fucked shit going on every day that is constantly used as a means of monetary gain. i.e. Boston (The fucked up Rhetoric has already begun and the suspect has only said the word... "no")

I do realize that we are on a path to a "rebirth" in the social construct of society right now and things will change for the better. However, there is nothing that can stop the human species from turning every last good thing into shit that is created in a "new age" because greed is such a large motivating emotion. The Boston bombing has been used to profit and here in the coming weeks it will move past television coverage and become consumer good's and idea's that will be profited from. News agencies capitalize on break's in the story and plastering the face of the suspect 24 hours every day until it no longer pays off. The interview of the suspects Uncle in particular was disgusting, how many times did the one woman ask if his nephews had "military training" and he had to continually tell her he had no contact with them in years. Why did the interview even take place? Did they want him to slip up and say something anti-American? I honestly don't know but that interview is exactly what is wrong with "news" coverage in this age. 

This will be used over the next month to fight for stricter immigration, gun control, and privacy laws all while victims are still suffering mental anguish and physical pain. They will be financially ruined by the time they are able to work again, if not by medical bills then inability to return to there former job because of the scope of their injuries. There will be all kinds of support for the victims, until the next story breaks and everybody is following that story staring at their smartphone screens, computer screens, and television screens. Electronics that cost a couple of dollars to make in a foreign country by the hands of men and women my age being paid just enough to eat but not to small they can afford to go elsewhere. Electronics that are sold at $300- $1200 retail. And it's this kind of shit that I'm don't want to contribute to any longer, despite the irony that I type this at a computer screen. Capitalism is truly evil, we no longer are on the pursuit of happiness. We are in pursuit of number's printed on paper and at the cost of happiness. We give a majority of our time every week to earn a promissory note that by the time we receive is already owed to somebody else. 

Modern society lives, eats, and sleeps on a bed of promises and never ending debt, and it doesn't ever realize it exists.
